meta.title: Add RequestContent.Create(IPersistableModel) overload for improved performance
meta.body_summary: Add a new RequestContent.Create<T> overload for IPersistableModel<T> that wraps BinaryContent to achieve allocation‑free streaming serialisation, replacing the buffering Utf8JsonRequestContent pattern.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added RequestContent.Create overload leveraging BinaryContent for allocation‑free streaming; initial CHANGES_REQUESTED for perf evidence and API generalisation; addressed with explanation and broadened to IPersistableModel; merged after clarifying design and adding tests.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 397 changed lines across 10 files, this is a small‑to‑medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated on adding a new overload and comprehensive tests. It fits an incremental performance API enhancement that merged after iterative review on design and evidence.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer KrzysztofCwalina CHANGES_REQUESTED asking how the change improves performance; Copilot replied with a detailed explanation citing MemoryStream vs UnsafeBufferSequence and ~30% speedup / 80% allocation reduction, leading to approval.
review_details.performance_claim: Provides allocation‑free network streaming by leveraging BinaryContent's optimised serialisation, eliminating intermediate MemoryStream buffering.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot added a new API overload with claimed performance improvement; maintainers required a technical explanation of the underlying streaming optimisation before acceptance, showing that performance claims in systemic SDK code need concrete evidence.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers reviewed the inner class design and questioned the need for a wrapper; also asked to use IPersistableModel instead of IJsonModel.
detection_detail.internal_benchmark_knowledge: m-nash cited ~30% speed improvement and ~80% allocation reduction from internal benchmarks of UnsafeBufferSequence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Performance claim not backed by included benchmarks; improvement acknowledged based on internal knowledge of Azure SDK internals.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After KrzysztofCwalina CHANGES_REQUESTED, Copilot explained the streaming optimisation in a PR comment, and further design adjustments (IPersistableModel) and test enhancements were made, leading to eventual approval.

core_change_summary.description: Added new RequestContent.Create<T> overload for IPersistableModel<T>, implemented as a PersistableModelRequestContent<T> wrapper around BinaryContent.Create<T> to enable allocation‑free streaming serialisation; added unit tests for sync/async, mixed formats, and IPersistableModel‑only models.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: API surface files regenerated and CHANGELOG updated.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and implementation with IJsonModel<T> constraint.
Update API surface manually (later corrected to use automatic generation).
Switched generic constraint to IPersistableModel<T> per review feedback.
Extended tests to cover IPersistableModel‑only and mixed‑format models as requested.

review_signals.summary: Requested to use IPersistableModel<T> instead of IJsonModel<T> for broader applicability.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot updated the constraint and all API surface files accordingly.

review_signals.summary: Instructed not to modify API files manually; they should be regenerated via the project script.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted manual changes and regenerated the API files using Export-API.ps1.

review_signals.summary: Challenged the performance claim in the title, asking 'How?'
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot replied with a detailed PR comment explaining the streaming optimisation and referenced internal benchmarks.

review_signals.summary: Provided internal performance data: ~30% faster and ~80% fewer allocations with UnsafeBufferSequence.
Linked to UnsafeBufferSequence implementation to clarify the optimisation.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with IJsonModel-based overload; JoshLove-msft requested IPersistableModel and API regeneration within ~15 minutes.
After switching to IPersistableModel, KrzysztofCwalina CHANGES_REQUESTED, asking for performance justification.
Copilot explained the streaming optimisation in a PR comment; m-nash and JoshLove-msft provided internal benchmark data and code pointers.
KrzysztofCwalina acknowledged the explanation and approved; two further approvals followed, and PR merged in under 6 hours.
